title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Tufts University.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England and Tufts University's Responses to the Attorney General's First Set of Document and Information Requests. By Thomas P. O'Neill. DPU 08-GC-6

The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 08-GC-6.
Attorney General First Set of Document and Information Requests. By Ronald J. Ritchie. DPU 08-GC-6
